metadata.source: Historical runtime road edges and USGS 2023 DEM
metadata.license: ODbL 1.0 road derived geometry; public domain USGS terrain
metadata.transition_boundary: 6 meter polygon buffer, 32 segments per quadrant; chord inset at round joins at most 0.001808 meter. Boundary and exterior heights exactly raw DEM triangle planes.
metadata.limitations: Visual shoulder blend; provisional historical widths and curbs; not surveyed road margins. Road boundary subdivision introduces T junctions with the existing road mesh, although segment heights coincide. Not a manifold topology guarantee.
